Method: loads the committed P22 WP2 impact_surface.json read-only; for each book, tests for a zero crossing in costed Sharpe across the impact-coefficient grid (positive at coefficient=0, negative at some higher coefficient); if a crossing exists, computes the break-even coefficient via fixed-iteration bisection (50 iterations) proving each bracket halves every iteration; books without a crossing are censored with a documented reason, never a midpoint; a per-row zero-crossing sign test is pinned for every active book; never regenerates or imports any P21/P22 WP0-WP2 harness.

Caveat: Break-even on a planted synthetic universe proves the estimator's capacity under market impact; it is never market alpha. A null-universe break-even is undefined (censored). NO-GO for market deployment until a maintainer supplies a licensed price series.
